body:
Add a finite BTCUSDT alpha/beta evaluation round for ordinary-exit confirmation, whole-account stop-risk budgeting, and causal crowding/trend interaction, with frozen causal features, original shared-session accounting, actual training-only risk sizing, executable controls, and independently funded Spot/Coin portfolio comparisons. Current canonical defaults and read-only/native gates remain in place until complete independent financial acceptance and any required source bridge.

The manual paper-ledger adapter binds reviewed final accounts and canonical source, retains original public bytes, and independently reconstructs modeled money. The reviewed checkpoint at `75c7d8efb07c98d21f1350d0f6186b48ed48a5a2` closes four ownership, protection, sizing and checkpoint issues. 58 affected tests pass (7 nonapplicable skips), with retained exact-commit synthetic CLI audits; these are engineering checks, not historical return results or native qualification.

This is a draft complete-delivery branch. The 52 unscaled, 8 actual-risk, 2 timing-diagnostic and 6 baseline-budget accounts are registered but not launched. Applicable ALL-eligible combinations and selected-budget cases follow the fixed contract. Public-data publication/readiness fixes, full replay and independent financial review, final adoption/evidence and integration remain in progress. Native cases and actual account-days are zero; no prospective alpha is established.
